description: AXIS agent process model. States, legal transitions, and signals. Source of truth for the Python runtime and TS control plane.

pid.notes: PIDs are globally unique and time-sortable. They are NOT tenant-secret; tenant scoping is enforced by tenant_id on every row and message. ppid is stored separately; the init process of a run has ppid null.

PAUSE.description: Suspend at the next safe point; state is checkpointed in the event log.

RESUME.description: Return a suspended process to ready.

TERM.description: Request shutdown; process may finish the current step. Escalates to KILL after the grace period.

KILL.description: Immediate termination; in-flight external actions are not started. Also delivered by kill-switches.

INTERRUPT.description: Deliver an out-of-band message without a state change (e.g. human takeover notice).

invariants: terminated is absorbing: no transition leaves it.
KILL is legal from every non-terminal state.
Terminating a parent sends TERM then KILL to all children (exit reason parent_terminated).
Every transition is an event in the run's append-only log and an audit event (enforcement_point: lifecycle).
